label: g1152-ewr-perf
_why: PROBE 5 OF THE PRE-1.2 PROBES (the user's go-ahead, 2026-11-20: "Yep, go on and launch them whenever ready", to the seven-probe proposal of the same evening): the TICK COST of the research-weight rule's better form (BALANCE_FRAMEWORK 10.119 item 3), a PERFORMANCE probe. The canon against the canon + research_events.entry_weight_rule { lowered 0.8, advancing 0.1 } (emit_tech_finish.mjs, 2026-11-20): 107 technologies with a research entry - 97 literacy-gated, 10 naval - take x 0.1 while one of their entry's stages is open with progress on its bar, else x 0.8 at the entry's literacy line (naval always); the 6 frontline entries keep full weight; the finish boost's add still comes last. The rule is evaluated only when a country picks research (F160), so its cost is expected to be small: what is measured is whether it is visible at all. Alternating, so the wall clock compares the same minutes (TESTBED_OPERATIONS 7). The ewr book is a probe build, never economy data: its figures are the user's starting ones, which probe 4 and the research model settle.

_arms.canon: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.g1151-canon-bz-dcu-ra-il-aw.json} - the canon (sha256 697d4869aefc3225), its debug build + telemetry
_arms.ewr: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.g1151-canon-bz-dcu-ra-il-aw-ewr.json} - the canon + research_events.entry_weight_rule (sha256 d1941a9fcec18099; field diff: that key and its _ewr_variant record only)

_comparison: seconds of wall clock per in-game year, run by run, the ewr runs against the canon runs played beside them (wall_clusters.mjs, run.log tick lines); the research picks are not read from this probe.

_predictions.cost: inside the noise between two runs of one arm (a few percent at most): the rule adds one literacy comparison and up to a few je: lookups per researchable technology, evaluated only when a country picks research
_predictions.if_visible: if the ewr arm is slower by more than the canon's own run-to-run spread, a x10-worsened arm (the rule's block repeated ten times) decides whether it is the rule; that arm is not in this schedule
_predictions.game: four runs of about 12-13 minutes, with builds about 60 minutes

_stop_rule: none: every run plays to its date.
_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30).
